(Judgment of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM,J.)

The writ petitions have been instituted challenging the notifications issued by the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Tamil Nadu State on 23.05.2024 / 23.05.2023 respectively, imposing ban of manufacture, storage, transport, distribution or sale of chewable food products, gutkha, panmasala,
containing tobacco and nicotine as ingredients in the State of Tamil Nadu for a period of one year from 23.05.2024 / 23.05.2023 respectively, under the Food Safety and Drug Administration Order.

entities.text: Food Safety and Drug Administration Order
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: _ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
Pertinently, the validity of the impugned notifications is for a period of one year with effect from 23.05.2024 / 23.05.2023.
Thus the ban, as per the impugned notifications, is to expire on 22.05.2025 and/or expired on 23.05.2024.
If at all the petitioner is aggrieved on account of any subsequent notification being issued, he is at liberty to initiate all appropriate action.
As far as the impugned notifications are concerned, the ban is to expire / expired and thus no adjudication is required.
Accordingly, the writ petitions stand closed.

Consequently, W.M.P.Nos.23370, 23372,
11019 & 11021 of 2024 are also closed.
No costs.
